question: qui à créer le projet nommée '038' ?
sql: SELECT owner FROM public.ordo_project WHERE name = '038';

question: quels projets comporte le plus de risques ?
sql:
SELECT op.NAME AS project_name,
       COUNT(r.ONB) AS risk_count
FROM ORDO_PROJECT op
LEFT JOIN OPX2__WF_PT_RISKS r ON r.DATASET = op.ONB
GROUP BY op.NAME
ORDER BY risk_count DESC;

question: quels projets comporte le plus de risques ?
sql:
SELECT op.NAME AS project_name,
       COUNT(r.ONB) AS risk_count,
       r.NAME AS risk_name,
       r.OPX2_COMMENT AS risk_comment,
       r.OPX2__WF_AA_N_RISK_STATE AS risk_state
FROM ORDO_PROJECT op
JOIN OPX2__WF_PT_RISKS r ON r.DATASET = op.ONB
WHERE r.OPX2__WF_AA_B_MANAGED = true
GROUP BY op.NAME, r.NAME, r.OPX2_COMMENT, r.OPX2__WF_AA_N_RISK_STATE
ORDER BY risk_count DESC;
